The Battle of Añyraqai or also as the Battle of Anrakai was a military battle between the Kazakh Khanate and the Dzungar Khanate in April 1730. The Kazaks defeated the Dzungars and expelled them from northwestern Jetisu. This led to the Kazakh resettlement on the Ili River.
